meta.prompt: Show what is playing right now as an inline music card, playing at 1:14 into the track: Midnight City by M83, 4:03 long, with drawn album art, a progress bar with the elapsed time and the time remaining, previous, play or pause and next buttons, and a like button that reads "Like" and, once pressed, "Liked". Under it the next three tracks in the queue: Golden Hour, JVKE, 3:29; Ocean Eyes, Billie Eilish, 3:20; Electric Feel, MGMT, 3:49 (after those comes Dreams, Fleetwood Mac, 4:17). Next moves on to the following track from 0:00 and the queue moves up with it.
meta.text:
state playing=true
state liked=false
state pos=74
state queue=[{"title":"Golden Hour","artist":"JVKE","len":209,"tone":"sand","kind":"mountain"},{"title":"Ocean Eyes","artist":"Billie Eilish","len":200,"tone":"sky","kind":"lagoon"},{"title":"Electric Feel","artist":"MGMT","len":229,"tone":"rose","kind":"dunes"},{"title":"Dreams","artist":"Fleetwood Mac","len":257,"tone":"lilac","kind":"skyline"}]
let track = "Midnight City"
let artist = "M83"
let total = 243
let left = total - pos
every 1000 -> pos = playing && pos < total ? pos + 1 : pos
if pos >= total
  every 1000 -> pos = 0

Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  Row gap:12 middle
    Media kind:"skyline" tone:"dusk" w:56 h:56
    Column gap:2 grow
      Text.heading "{track}"
      Text.muted "{artist}"
    IconButton "favorite" -> liked = !liked
    Text.muted "{liked ? "Liked" : "Like"}"
  Column gap:4
    Progress =pos
    Row between
      Text.caption "{formatTime(pos)}"
      Text.caption "-{formatTime(left)}"
  Row center gap:24
    IconButton "skip_previous" -> pos = 0
    IconButton "{playing ? "pause" : "play_arrow"}" -> playing = !playing
    IconButton "skip_next" -> track = queue[0].title; artist = queue[0].artist; total = queue[0].len; pos = 0; queue = removeAt(queue, 0)
  Text.sectionTitle "Up next"
  each t in queue
    ListTile "{t.title}" "{t.artist}"
      Media kind:"{t.kind}" tone:"{t.tone}" w:40 h:40
